## 3. Reference fact kinds and schemas

- **common**: REFERENCE batches. Rows of one role are emitted ordered by (effective_start_ns, reference_id) as the shared validator requires. instrument_id = member (declared/observed breadth) or the target entity (adaptive); session_id = target session. All fact roles of one request share one source_id and snapshot_id; text is null except where stated.
- **population**:
  - **fact_kind**: ef3.population.member
  - **defined_by**: contract E (ROBUST_PACE, PR 690, OQ-7), reused unchanged for the declared static population: one row per declared member, instrument_id = member, session_id = target session, reference_id x1:B(population_id) identical across members, effective bounds = target session bounds, text = snapshot id, price and factors null, known_at_ns nullable
- **membership_interval**:
  - **fact_kind**: ef3.breadth.membership_interval
  - **why_distinct**: E kind pins effective bounds to the session and has no stint identity, so it cannot express joins, leaves or re-entry; this kind is used only when membership_profile = ordered_history
  - **reference_id**: bh1:B(population_id):B(population_revision):stint6
  - **effective_start_ns/effective_end_ns**: membership interval [start, end), end null = open
  - **text**: snapshot id
- **prior_reference_availability**:
  - **fact_kinds**:
    - ef3.member.prior_reference.available
    - ef3.member.prior_reference.unavailable
  - **reference_id**: bf1:B(population_id)
  - **value**: none (fact_kind carries the state)
- **current_return**:
  - **fact_kind**: ef3.member.current_return
  - **price**: signed int64 coefficient, only its sign is consumed; null = null_field
- **cumulative_volume**:
  - **fact_kind**: ef3.member.cumulative_volume
  - **price**: int64 shares >= 0 (library refuses negative with BOUNDS); null = null_field
- **endpoint_price**:
  - **fact_kind**: ef3.member.endpoint_price
  - **price**: positive int64 coefficient at PriceUnit.scale; effective_start_ns = member event time
- **vwap**:
  - **fact_kinds**:
    - ef3.member.vwap
    - ef3.member.vwap.unavailable
  - **price**: notional coefficient at PriceUnit.scale
  - **factor_num**: 1
  - **factor_den**: cumulative volume in shares (positive); VWAP coefficient = price*factor_num/factor_den exactly
- **momentum**:
  - **fact_kind**: ef3.member.momentum
  - **price**: signed int64, only sign consumed; null = null_field
- **selected_high / selected_low**:
  - **fact_kinds**:
    - ef3.member.selected_high
    - ef3.member.selected_low
  - **price**: positive int64 coefficient
- **members (observed)**:
  - **fact_kind**: ef3.observed.member
  - **reference_id**: ob1:B(record_set_id)
  - **text**: group label or null (not the snapshot id)
  - **effective_start_ns**: record time; records at or after C are not yet observed
- **change / qualifier_price / qualifier_volume (observed)**:
  - **fact_kinds**:
    - ef3.observed.change
    - ef3.observed.qualifier_price
    - ef3.observed.qualifier_volume
  - **price**: change: signed, sign only; qualifier_price: positive coefficient at scale; qualifier_volume: int64 shares >= 0
- **observations (adaptive)**:
  - **fact_kind**: ef3.adaptive.rate
  - **reference_id**: ao1:B(epoch):seq19:B(event_id)
  - **effective_start_ns**: event time t_k
  - **price/factor_num/factor_den**: supplied raw rate in shares per second = price*factor_num/factor_den; factors both null (meaning 1/1) or both positive; price >= 0; null price = null_field
  - **text**: snapshot id

The schemas are listed for the whole core contract file, that is for all of its producers.

## 6. Input-stage refusals

The core contract states no separate refusal order.

Refusal codes the core contract records for this producer (distinct code and raising layer; fixture ids are core ids):

| Code | Raised by | Fixtures | Example (core text) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `BOUNDS` | library | RB09, RB24, RO09, RO13, RA05, RA15 | negative cumulative volume in the price column |
| `BOUNDS` | shared validator | RB11 | membership interval with end <= start |
| `DUPLICATE` | library | RB03, RA02 | ordered_history: member b has two stints that overlap in time (even if only one contains C): same identity at the same time, extension of contract E RF12 |
| `DUPLICATE` | shared validator | RB01, RB02, RO01, RA01 | declared population lists member a twice (same instrument, session, reference_id): contract E RF12 / OQ-7 |
| `INCOMPATIBLE_VERSION` | library | RB20, RO11, RA10 | policy_version other than ef3-breadth1 |
| `INCONSISTENT_IDENTITY` | library | RB04, RB05, RB06, RB07, RB25, RO02 (+3 more) | a fact role carries a row for member z that is not declared in the population (never silently dropped) |
| `INVALID_CONFIG` | library | RB16, RB17, RB18, RB19, RB29, RO03 (+8 more) | near_high tolerance 5/4 (above 1) |
| `INVALID_ORDER` | library | RA03 | sequence decreases while event time increases |
| `INVALID_ORDER` | shared validator | RB08, RA14 | ordered_history: the stints of ONE member are not in (effective_start_ns, reference_id) order. The shared validator checks order per (instrument, session) group, so a one-row-per-member role (instrument_id = member) can never raise INVALID_ORDER; the check applies to multi-stint membership intervals and to the adaptive stream only |
| `INVALID_SCHEMA` | library | RB13, RB14, RB15, RB28, RB26, RO07 (+3 more) | a role carries a fact_kind of another role |
| `INVALID_UNIT` | shared compatibility check | RB12, RB30, RO10 | two roles declare different PriceUnit (scale or currency) |
| `OVERFLOW` | library | RB23, RB27 | sum of advancing members volumes above 2^63-1 with up_volume selected (published value out of int64; whole request refused) |
| `UNKNOWN_FEATURE` | library | RB21 | selected feature id not produced by session_breadth |
| `UNSUPPORTED_ADJUSTMENT` | shared validator | RB10, RA06 | vwap factor_den = 0 (rational factors must be positive) |
| `UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY` | library | RB22, RO12, RA11 | update, restore or merge requested (no state capability in v1) |
